To combat this, companies must rethink traditional security models and adopt comprehensive, AI-enabled security architectures that are always active and deeply embedded across all system layers.

Observability—being able to monitor, understand, and govern agent behavior—will be a key part of this defense strategy. Jakkal stresses the need for shared responsibility among security, IT, and development teams to ensure identity and data security. Human oversight remains essential to building trust, especially as AI agents become more widespread and complex. With over 1.3 billion agents expected by 2028, securing these systems akin to how people are protected is vital. Jakkal concludes that proactive, integrated security can not only mitigate risk but also become a transformative force for enterprise innovation.
